name: Loading UI
tagline: Spinners, loaders and loading animations, free forever
description: A curated set of CSS and React loading states: rings, dots, bars, text shimmer, skeletons, each with a one-click copy button. Grew out of the TurboStarter SaaS kit, so the components lean toward what a real product actually needs rather than novelty spinners.

best.note: Every loader on one page, copy the component directly.
